T: Get to the chopper. Then get to dinner.
D: An elite rescue team gets hunted by an alien in the Central American jungle.
P: Serve the snacks when Dutch and Dillon do that famous handshake.
S: Thin-sliced topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and dried chilli, slow-dried until chewy with a slow-building heat. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Marinate the beef overnight. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but bendy. Cool and store airtight.
Black beans, garlic, cumin and lime blended, topped with feta, corn chips
Black beans blitzed with garlic, cumin and lime, topped with crumbled feta, coriander and green chilli. Corn chips.
Thin fried green plantain chips with lime zest salt
Green plantains sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 175C until crisp, salted with lime zest.
M: Smoked paprika rump steaks grilled hard, with garlic parsley chili sauce
Rump steak rubbed with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, grilled over high heat, rested, chimichurri.
Val Verde achiote chicken, rice and beans

Chicken thighs braised in achiote, orange and sofrito until tender, with black beans, white rice and sweet fried plantain. Fry 1 diced onion, 1 diced red capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil for 8 minutes. Add 1 tbsp achiote paste, 1 tsp cumin, the juice of 2 oranges and 200ml chicken stock. Add 1kg chicken thighs, cover and simmer 35 minutes until tender. Cook 300g rice. Warm a drained 400g tin black beans with a pinch of cumin. Slice 2 ripe plantains on the angle and fry in oil until caramelised.
W: Dense chocolate mud cake with a chocolate cream glaze
Dense mud cake baked at 160C for 70 minutes, ganache poured over and dragged with a fork like mud.
K: Dark rum, pineapple, passionfruit and lime over crushed ice

Dark rum, passionfruit, pineapple and lime shaken with a dash of grenadine, poured over crushed ice and topped with grated nutmeg. Shake 180ml dark rum, 120ml pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, 60ml fresh lime juice and 20ml grenadine with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Grate a little nutmeg on top of each and garnish with a pineapple wedge.

steps.text: Blitz the beans with the garlic, cumin and lime juice until smooth.
Spread in a bowl and top with the feta, coriander and green chilli.
Serve with the corn chips.
Peel the plantains and slice very thin on a mandoline.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 175C in batches until crisp, about 2 minutes each.
Mix the flaky salt with the lime zest and toss through the hot chips.

steps.text: Rub the steaks with salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, oil and chilli flakes.
Grill over high heat, turning once.
Rest the steaks, then spoon over the chimichurri.

steps.text: Cut each cauliflower into 2 thick steaks and rub with the olive oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, extra virgin olive oil and chilli flakes.
Grill over high heat, turning once, until charred and tender.
Spoon the chimichurri over the cauliflower steaks.
Heat the oven to 160C and line a cake tin. Melt part of the chocolate with the butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk in the eggs and sugar, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Bake until a skewer comes out with just a few crumbs, then cool in the tin.
Heat the cream, melt in the remaining chocolate, pour over the cake and drag with a fork.

s.note: Black bean dip with feta, coriander and green chilli
s.how: Blitz 2 drained tins black beans with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and the juice of 2 limes until smooth. Spread in a bowl and top with 80g crumbled feta, coriander and a sliced green chilli. Serve with corn chips.

s.note: Thin crisp green plantain chips with lime salt
s.how: Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin on a mandoline. Fry at 175C in batches until crisp, about 2 minutes. Drain and toss straight away with flaky salt mixed with the zest of a lime.

m.note: Smoky paprika rump grilled hot, with sharp green chimichurri
m.how: Rub 4 rump steaks with salt, pepper and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side and rest. Chop a bunch of parsley with 2 garlic cloves and mix with 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 100ml oil and chilli flakes. Spoon over.

w.note: Dense chocolate mud cake with ganache dragged like mud
w.how: Melt 250g dark chocolate and 250g butter. Whisk in 4 eggs and 300g sugar, then fold in 150g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 160C for 70 minutes. Melt 150g chocolate with 150ml cream, pour over and drag with a fork.
